blocks.text: Hypothesis test karna ek wazeh process par chalta hai (Figure 7.1 dekhein). Process hypotheses tay karne se shuru hota hai. Phir data dhyan se jama kiya jata hai, test statistics nikale jate hain, nataij ko muqarrar miyar (criteria) se milaya jata hai, aur aakhir mein faisla hota hai. Sahi qadam ghaltiyan kam karte hain aur test ko munsifana (fair) rakhte hain. Hypothesis testing qabil-e-bharosa nateejon tak le jati hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Testing wazeh qadmon par chalti hai. Data jama aur analyze hota hai. Nataij ko miyar se milaya jata hai. Nateeje dhyan se nikale jate hain. Durust tests qabil-e-bharosa nataij dete hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar dabbe oopar se neeche, teeron se jure: 1. State the Hypothesis, 2. Set Significance Level, 3. Collect Data, 4. Perform a Test. Aakhri dabbe se do mure hue teer nikalte hain: baen taraf 'If p-value > α' se sabz dabba 'Accept Hypothesis'; daen taraf 'If p-value < α' se surkh dabba 'Reject Hypothesis'.

blocks.long_description: Chaar qadam oopar se neeche chalte hain; aakhir mein p-value ka α se muqabla (comparison) faisla karta hai ke kaunsa nateeja hoga.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 7.1 mein p-value > α par 'Accept Hypothesis' likha hai. Statistics mein behtar alfaaz 'H₀ reject nahi hota' hain, kyunke test sirf yeh batata hai ke H₀ ke khilaf saboot kafi nahi mila; yeh H₀ ko sach sabit nahi karta. p-value < α ho to H₀ reject hota hai.
